tasks.step:
Carry out visual inspection of chaser lighting at each Emergency door position and check for damage.
Carry out repair / replacement to damaged units as necessary.

Manually operate the system at each door position. Ensure that:
Each arrow functions and is sequential.
Strobe lighting on sign operates and sign is illuminated.
Audible sound and white noise alert are operational
Replace any defective components necessary to bring the system back into full service.
Inspect control panel for signs of water ingress and security of all connections and components.
Operate door from EPCMS and log door checked.
